reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for L-carnitine, that's a supplement dose, and it's one for a doctor or a registered dietitian who knows your health and what else you take. In general, it's a compound the body makes on its own, it's sold as a supplement for fat metabolism and recovery, and the evidence for those claims is modest at best. Your training and eating will do far more than it will.

If you tell me what you're after, whether that's fat loss, recovery or performance, I can help on the training side.
